summary.text: Luis Garcia is the Democratic candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 91, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A retired firefighter and paramedic, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he served 28 years in that work and is also a former business owner and licensed claims adjuster.

paragraphs.text: Garcia graduated from Miami Coral Park Senior High, according to Ballotpedia.
His survey responses say he was born in Colombia, became a naturalized citizen, grew up in Miami, and is a father of two adult sons.

In the survey, Garcia listed community service work including founding a 501(c)(3) organization that he said has helped save more than 500 people with Narcan, and volunteer experience as a CPR, first aid and AED instructor.
He said his campaign aims to bring bipartisanship, civility and stability to South Florida politics and to meet with constituents of all parties.
